name: Haruma Kazushi
source:
One of the few boys that came to Eiden island to transfer schools. Just like his best friends, he is bored of his virgin life and is on a quest to find himself a girlfriend. And so his exciting adventures at the new school finally begin.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Edelweiss_%28visual_novel%29]Wikipedia[/url]]
